svg.title: LSD: Dream Emulator decompilation progress map
svg.desc: Rectangle area is code bytes. Every game function is matching C. Dark green: still named by address. Mid green: named, with unknown fields or locals inside. Light green: every name in its body is ours. Grey hatched: Sony library linked as is. Hover for details.

g.text: Matching SLPS_015.56 verified · 2f6b18c · 1,458 game functions, 210,172 code bytes, all in C
100% of game code in matching C · 1,299 of 1,458 functions use only our names
Sony library (40% of the exe code), linked as is
